title: Josephus problem
prompt: Some people stand in a circle, numbered 1 to n. Starting with person 1, you count around the circle and every k-th person still in the circle is removed, until one person is left. Print the number of the last person left for each of these cases, one per line, in this order: n = 7 with k = 3, n = 41 with k = 3, n = 10 with k = 2.
